tour.title: Project Architecture & Vision
tour.description: Start with StudioFlow's README and manifest to understand the single-designer financial back-office concept and architecture.

tour.title: Frontend Boot & Orchestration
tour.description: Explore how Vite boots the React application and mounts App.jsx, which coordinates state, views, and notifications.

tour.title: Receivables Aging & WhatsApp Reminders
tour.description: Discover the accounts receivable aging bucket tiers and client follow-up reminder generator.

tour.title: Cash Forecasting & What-If Simulation
tour.description: Understand the financial trajectory forecasting engine and interactive sliders modeling payment delay scenarios.

tour.title: Crisis Triage & Outflows Management
tour.description: Inspect the Bad Day crisis triage modal and outgoing studio expense manager.

tour.title: Invoicing & NLP Parsing
tour.description: Examine invoice authoring and the natural language command parser converting text into draft invoices.

tour.title: Offline-First Data Synchronization
tour.description: Review the unified data layer gracefully falling back across Express API, Supabase cloud, and localStorage.

tour.title: Backend Express Server & Storage
tour.description: Inspect the Express 5 backend server mounting API routes and persisting state to server/data/db.json.

tour.title: Server Calculation Engines
tour.description: Explore the server-side cash forecast math and regex-based invoice natural language parsing.

tour.title: Verification & Automated Testing
tour.description: See the backend integration tests and client verification suites guaranteeing correctness.
